newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to sell Italian-made scooter in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Honda to sell Italian-made scooter in Japan.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it would import scooters made at its Italian subsidiary to sell in Japan.
The Honda Via, 50cc scooter, made by Honda Italia Industriale SpA, based in Attesa near Rome, will go on sale on July 18, Honda said in a statement.
Annual sales are targetted at 3,000 units, it said.
Honda already sells motorcycles made at its overseas units in Japan, such as the 1,520cc Gold Wing and Valkyrie, made at Honda's Ohio plant, and the C100 moped, made at its Thailand unit.
Honda's motorcycle sales in Japan rose a marginal 0.6 percent to 645,000 units in the business year to March 1997.
In May, Honda said it wanted to boost its domestic motorcycle sales to 710,000 units this year.
